tools.name: check_claim
tools.title: Check a claim
tools.description: Check a claim with ACHP's seven agents and return the verdict, each checkable part with its label, and the sources it rests on (verbatim quotes). Progress is reported as agents finish. If the run is not done within wait_seconds, the result has status "running" and no verdict; call get_check with the run_id later.

params.name: text
params.description: The message or claim to check, as the person received it.

params.name: library_id
params.description: Check against this library (from list_libraries) as well as the web.

params.name: wait_seconds
params.description: How long to wait for the verdict before returning the run id.

tools.name: start_check
tools.title: Start a check
tools.description: Start a check and return its run id at once, without waiting. Read it later with get_check.

params.name: text
params.description: The message or claim to check.

tools.name: get_check
tools.title: Read a check
tools.description: Where a check stands. Finished: the verdict, parts and sources. Running: which agents are working, and no verdict. Failed: the stage and the reason, and no verdict.

params.name: run_id
params.description: A run id from check_claim or start_check.

tools.name: get_check_events
tools.title: Read a check's event log
tools.description: The run's raw event log (protocol v2): every agent action, public note, source, mark and the verdict, in order. It is what the case page is built from. It holds no model reasoning.

params.name: since
params.description: Only events after this sequence number.

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.title: List libraries
tools.description: The libraries (uploaded documents) a check or a question can use, with their status and size.

tools.name: ask_library
tools.title: Ask a library
tools.description: Answer only from one library. Every sentence carries a [N] marker for a retrieved passage; an answer with no marker means the library does not say.

tools.name: search_library
tools.title: Search a library
tools.description: Find stored passages in a library that contain the words, verbatim. A plain text match, not an answer.

params.name: query
params.description: Words to look for in the stored passages.

tools.name: backend_status
tools.title: Is ACHP awake
tools.description: Whether the ACHP backend answers. A free-tier server can take up to a minute to wake after a quiet spell.

resources.title: What the scores mean
resources.description: The five scores' full names and how to read them. They are instruments, not the verdict.

resources.title: A check, readable
resources.description: A finished check as short Markdown: the verdict, each part and its quoted sources.

resources.title: A check's event log
resources.description: The run's full event log (protocol v2).

prompts.name: check_before_forwarding
prompts.title: Check before forwarding
prompts.description: Check a message someone wants to forward, and report it the way ACHP's site does.
